    def validate_metadata_and_restore_db(self, metadata, user_type: Optional[str] = None, always_restore: bool = False):
        """
        Validate metadata like validate_metadata_match(). Only when validation FAILS,
        attempt to restore DB value to metadata.value.old. Optionally, force restore
        via always_restore=True.
    
        Args:
            metadata: Response metadata dictionary expected to include 'section', 'entry', and 'value.old'.
            user_type: Optional user type to use for DB operation (e.g., "Admin").
            always_restore: When True, attempt DB restore even if validation passes.
        """
        if not metadata:
            return
        validation_error = None
        try:
            # Validate section/entry against the sheet
            self.validate_metadata_match(metadata)
        except AssertionError as e:
            validation_error = e
            allure.attach(str(e), name="Metadata Validation Error", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
        restore_attempted = False
        restore_success = False
        restore_error = None
        should_restore = always_restore or (validation_error is not None)
        if should_restore:
            # Attempt to restore DB from metadata old value
            try:
                restore_attempted = True
                restore_success = self.client.revert_config_entry_from_metadata(metadata, user_type=user_type)
                allure.attach(str(restore_success), name="Restored DB to metadata.old", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
            except Exception as e:
                restore_error = e
                allure.attach(str(metadata), name="Metadata (restore failure)", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(e), name="Restore Exception", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
        # If validation failed, raise after attempting restore
        if validation_error is not None:
            details = f"Restore attempted={restore_attempted}, success={restore_success}"
            if restore_error is not None:
                details += f", restore_error={restore_error}"
